IPV_Cochrane.title: Psychological therapies for women who experience intimate partner violence
IPV_Cochrane.limitations: therapist-delivered interventions; app adaptations not directly established

WHO_IPV.title: WHO Health care for women subjected to IPV or sexual violence: clinical handbook
WHO_IPV.limitations: clinical guidance, not trial of ANEIRA exercises

VA_PTSD.title: VA/DoD 2023 PTSD clinical practice guideline
VA_PTSD.limitations: clinician-delivered CPT, EMDR and PE must not be copied into unsupervised app

NICE_PTSD.title: NICE NG116 PTSD recommendations
NICE_PTSD.limitations: supported digital trauma-focused CBT has strict eligibility and professional support requirements

BREATH.title: Fincham et al. 2023 breathwork meta-analysis
BREATH.limitations: moderate risk of bias; not IPV-specific; no direct proof of HPA repair

BA.title: Uphoff et al. 2020 behavioral activation for depression
BA.limitations: mostly low to moderate certainty, not ANEIRA-specific

CBTI.title: Edinger et al. 2021 AASM insomnia treatment guideline
CBTI.limitations: full CBT-I is a clinician-guided multi-component treatment; sleep hygiene alone insufficient

WRITING.title: Expressive writing for adult trauma survivors: network meta-analysis
WRITING.limitations: trauma disclosure can increase distress; supportive journaling not equivalent to writing therapy
